 Trabzonspor 2-0 Hearts: What Vrancken said 
 Image source, SNS Published 1 hour ago 
 Hearts head coach Wouter Vrancken tells BBC Scotland: "Against a good team like this, as I told you already, they paid so much money for new players and even got Salah on a free transfer, so they have a lot of quality in their team, individual quality. 
 "But what we showed against this individual quality was a real team today.
 "I was really proud of the performance."
 On starting Rogers Mato at fullback: "Yeah, I just talked with him today, actually, because Harry dropped out yesterday. 
 "So I talked with him today, but he was really clean and clear in his conversation
 "No problem, he said, and I told him a bit about his position, about also guarding Salah. 
 "I knew that he could match up the pace there and also I know that Rogers, when he's focused, that he's really strong in one-on-one duels especially for an offensive player. 
 "So happy to see that it worked out, because if Salah scores two, three times, everybody says it was a wrong decision and not a good one, but yeah, you have to have confidence in some guys.
 "And when you see some guys playing out of position because the need was there, we had only one midfielder left to play, six injured. 
 "So also there, Jordi Altena, his performance out of position was also great. 
 "So happy to see those things happening and that we can bounce back from the result of last weekend and have a good team performance."
